fit_reason: Whole classic car (1972 Ford LTD sedan) listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dull, flat-looking paint on the hood and trunk lid with little gloss in direct sun
Uneven sheen and dullness along the side panels and doors
Green vinyl roof looks faded and dusty, especially over the rear window area
Dirt and grime in the rear door jamb and on the sill plate
Rear bench seat vinyl looks dingy with visible soiling in the pleats
Loose item (blue cushion) left on the rear seat
Smudgy, faded interior door panel and lower door area on the rear door
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1972 LTD and it looks like a solid car. The paint on the hood and trunk looks a bit flat in the photos, and the rear bench and door jambs could use a cleanup. We do pre-sale details, including a machine buff and vinyl top refresh, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
